categories.main_business_segments: Muyuan Foods Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pig farming and pork processing. Its main business segments include pig breeding and sales, slaughtering, and meat product sales. The company has vertically integrated operations covering feed production, pig breeding, pig farming, slaughtering, and meat processing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding techniques including a two-way crossbreeding system and genetic evaluation. It uses smart farming technologies such as intelligent ventilation, feeding, environmental control, and automated inspection systems. Feed formulation innovations include low-soybean meal diets and dynamic nutrition models. The slaughtering and meat processing utilize automated and intelligent production lines to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Muyuan serves a broad range of customers including institutional buyers and individual customers across China. Its products cater to the domestic pork market, which is the largest globally. The company supplies fresh and frozen pork products to retail, wholesale, and food service sectors nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with pig farms and slaughterhouses in over 24 provinces and 25 provincial-level administrative regions. It has established a nationwide sales and service network covering 20 provinces. Subsidiaries and operations are spread throughout major agricultural and consumption regions in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Muyuan operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream feed production and pig breeding, midstream pig farming, and downstream slaughtering and meat processing. This integration allows control over the entire pork production value chain from feed to final meat products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in breeding, nutrition, disease prevention, and smart farming technologies. R&D priorities include developing high-quality pig breeds, optimizing feed formulations with reduced soybean meal, enhancing biosecurity and health management, and advancing automation and digitalization in farming and processing. It also invests in synthetic biology and biopharmaceuticals to expand by-product utilization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of live pigs, slaughtered pork products, and feed raw materials. Sales are recognized upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or customer receipt. The company also earns income from related services such as manure sales and leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Muyuan is one of the leading pig farming and pork processing companies in China, holding a significant market share among the top ten listed companies in the sector. It competes with other large-scale integrated pork producers and focuses on scale, vertical integration, and technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Muyuan reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 110.86 billion, a decrease of 11.19% from the previous year, and a net loss of RMB 4.17 billion. The company sold over 63.8 million pigs and processed 13.26 million pigs in slaughterhouses. Despite short-term profit decline due to market conditions, the company continues to expand capacity and invest in technology for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Muyuan emphasizes food safety, product quality, and cost control through its vertically integrated model. It offers traceable, high-quality pork products supported by strict biosecurity and quality management systems. The company differentiates itself with advanced breeding, nutrition optimization, and smart farming technologies that improve efficiency and product consistency, meeting growing consumer demand for safe and affordable pork.
